translation.name: Bab dummad Jesucristoba igar mesisad garda

content: Dule-geg-nanaed nudaklesad
Ibagwengine, Bab-Dummadse-goled-wachigi, Pedro, Juan-ebo Bab-Dummadse-goled-negse sedo wachi-ilapaagi nadap-gusmalad.

Deunni Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg-yawagak, Yeer-Daklegedye-nugad-naba dule-wargwen mellesii-gusad. We-dulede gwalulesad-akar gusgu geg nanaed. Bane-bane Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg-yawagak-naba sinoni-damalad, adi dulemar-bela-ubomaidse mani egisegar.
Dule-geg-nanaed, Pedro, Juan-ebo Bab-Dummadse-goled-negse dogmai dakargu, amarse mani egichialid.
Pedro, Juan-ebo nue-nuu dakdemargu, geb Pedro ega sogded: —Nue be anmar-dake.
Dule-geg-nanaed nue-nuu daksigis, ar mani ega ukoye bienad.
Pedrodi ega sogded: —An mani sate, degi, olo satebar, degi-inigwele, an ibmar-nikad an bega ukoed: Jesucristo-Nazaretgined-nuggi, be gwisgu, yog be nanaar-sae.
Deyob Pedro ega sogsagu, dule-argan-nuedsik gasa imasgu, ogwichiis imaksad. Agi yog e-nag gannaleded, degi, e-mali-garbirgwa yog nuguar-naded.

Dule-geg-nanaed ichomakdegu, yog gwisguar imaksad-sorba, yog nanaar-naded. A-sorba dule-nugusad, Pedro, degi, Juanmala Bab-Dummadse-goled-negse dogdemalad. Dule-nugusad ganna-ganna nadapi, ichomakmai, degi, Bab-Dummad-nug odummonai-gusad.
Bela dulemar daksamalad, dule-nugusad igi ganna-ganna nadap-gusa, degi, igi Bab-Dummad-nug ogannonai-gusbali.

Degisoggu, bela geger dakdemalad, degine, nue aku itomarbalid, wede igi gusa, ar ade wismalad, we-dule Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg-yawagak, Yeer-Daklegedye-nugad-naba sii-daed, mani emarse egichi-daed-duled.
Pedro sogsa-gusad, dule-geg-nanaed igi nugus gusa
Dule-geg-gusgu-nanaed-nugusadi, Pedro, degi, Juan, amargi akani, geg indakgusad. Geb degi bela dulemar duurmaknonimalad Babse-goled-neg-ubebse, Salomónye-nugadse, ar ade agi gunanaimalad.

Pedro deyob dulemar-dakargu, sogdesun: “Israel-dorgan, ¿ibiga bemar geger dakmarsunna? ¿Ar ibiga bemar nuu anmar-dake, anmar Bab-Dummadba-nued-nanaed-ular we-dule-nudaksadyob? Ar we-dule anmar-ganguedgi anmarde gwen nudaksasulid, Jesús-Nazaretgined-nuggi anmar nudaksad.

“Anmar-dadgan, Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, amar-Bab-Dummad, na E-Machi-Jesús-nug odummosad. A-Jesús-oburgwega, Dummad-Pilatoga bemar uksa-gusmalad. Deun Pilato Jesús-onobiguargu, onogega bemar gwen imaksasurmalad.
Bemar a-Jesús Dule-Gwage-Swilidikid, Dule-Igar-Napiragwadba-Ibmar-Imaked, a bemar egichissurmalad. Bur dule-iskana, dulemar-oburgwisad, a bemar Pilatose egichismalad bemarga onogegar.
Deyob bemar dulega-san-burba-ukedi oburgwis-gusmalad. Degi-inigwele, Bab Dummad, Jesús-burgwarmaigu odurgusad. A-durgusad, bela anmar-ibyanugi anmar daksamalad.
“Emide, we-dule nugus bemar dakedi, bemar nue wisidi, we Jesús-sunnad-nuggi-bensulidba nugusad. A Jesúsgi bensursoggu, we-dule nue nudakles bemar daksunnad.
“Gwenadgan, ar an wisid, bemar aku-neg-itomaladba Jesús-oburgwis-gusmalad, igi be-dummagan imaksamogadyob.
We degi-gusad, ar Bab Dummad bato idu anmarga E-gaya-burba-berbemaladba, sogsa-gusad, an-Machi-Cristo nue wilegoye. Agala deyob gusad.

Degisoggu, be-iskudiidga, ulubgi na be bukib binsamar, be-daed be ogwamarsun, Bab Dummadse gannar be dagmarsun, be-iskudiid bega osulogegar, adi Bab Dummad bemar-weligwar-imakedgi bemarga gwage-bogidikid ukegar.
Adi Bab Dummad, Cristo bato bemarga iduar uklegoye soglesad, barmidagegar. Ar a, Jesucristodo.
“Emidi a-Jesucristo bina nibneggi meggweler-gebed, bela Bab Dummad ibmar nue nudakedse. Ar deyob bato Bab Dummad epenne E-gaya-burba-berbemalad-gwage-swilidikmaladba sogsa-gusad.
Degisoggu, Moisés anmar-dadganga sogsa-gusad.

content.text: Igi bemarga sogdagoe, a-dule nue be itomalo.

content: “Degisoggu, bela Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba-berbemaladi, Samuel-akar, Cristogi bato iduar we-ibagangi sunmaksamalad.
Bemar Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba-berbemalad-e-wagan-gumarsoggu, Bab Dummad E-gaya-burba-berbemaladga ibmar-sogsadi bemargadmogad. Agi Bab Dummad anmar-dadgan-ebo igar nabosad, deun Abrahamga sogsa-gusgu:
Degisoggu, Bab Dummad na E-Machi-burgwar-maid odulosad-sorba, bemarse-inse barminonisunnad, adi ib-nuedga bemarga guegar, mer iskuedgi bemar bar nanaegar.”
